decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (  ) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - A splay of 2.4m x 2.4m shall be permanently provided on each side of the access, the depth measured from the back of the footway and the widths outwards from the edges of the access, and no fence, wall or other obstruction to visibility exceeding 0.6m in height above the surface of the adjoining highway shall be erected within the areas of such splays.
Condition : 4 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
Condition : 5 - No additional windows, doors or other glazed openings shall be formed in the front porch extension hereby approved.
Condition : 6 - The front porch extension hereby approved shall only be erected with a wheelchair accessible 1mm:15mm ramp in accordance with the design set out in the approved drawings.

Condition : 7 - The owner of No. 15a Cherry Crescent shall, within no more than three months of planning permission being hereby granted, undertake alterations to the site by reducing the height of the front boundary wall, gate and pillars to 0.6 metres high to ensure compliant 2.4 metre x 2.4 metre visibility splays are provided; replacing the existing side driveway gate with a matching side wall (continuing the line of the existing side garden wall and fence); replacing the existing side hardstanding with grass and flower beds and erecting a new wall/ fence to form a private side garden, encompassing the former side driveway footprint.  

The completion of these works would regularise the planning contraventions identified by the Local Planning Authority and ensure compliance with Condition 3 of Planning Permission 00239/15/P1.   Failure to comply with this condition within three months will result in the Local Planning Authority taking enforcement action against the owner of No. 15A Cherry Crescent, including if necessary serving a Breech of Condition Notice.
